<!-- ===== LENOVO DEVICE REFRESH — CONTENT ONLY (paste inside ShopIT CMS page) ===== -->
<!-- The store adds its own header/footer automatically, so this contains ONLY the page body. -->

<style>
  @import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Montserrat:wght@400;500;600;700;800&display=swap');

/* Gotham Rounded (subset, embedded) */
@font-face{font-family:'Gotham Rounded';font-style:normal;font-weight:400;font-display:swap;src:url(data:font/woff2;base64,) format('woff2')}
@font-face{font-family:'Gotham Rounded';font-style:normal;font-weight:500;font-display:swap;src:url(data:font/woff2;base64,) format('woff2')}
@font-face{font-family:'Gotham Rounded';font-style:normal;font-weight:700;font-display:swap;src:url(data:font/woff2;base64,) format('woff2')}
  :root{
    --head:'Gotham Round','Gotham Rounded','Montserrat','Segoe UI',Arial,sans-serif; /* uses Gotham Round where licensed, falls back to Montserrat */
    --ink:#25282A;        /* Pantone 426C - brand dark grey */
    --ink-2:#1c1e20;      /* slightly deeper for footer */
    --orange:#EE7623;     /* Pantone 158C - hero colour */
    --orange-dk:#d4621a;  /* darker orange for hover */
    --yellow:#F4AF23;     /* Pantone 4008C - accent */
    --grey:#616365;       /* Pantone 10C - logo grey */
    --paper:#ffffff;
    --mist:#f4f6f8;
    --line:#e3e8ec;
    --muted:#616365;      /* brand grey for body text */
    --lenovo:#e2231a;
  }
  *{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:0}
  html{scroll-behavior:smooth}
  body{
    font-family:'Gotham Rounded','Montserrat','Segoe UI','Helvetica Neue',Arial,sans-serif;
    color:var(--ink);background:var(--paper);line-height:1.55;
    -webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;
  }
  .wrap{max-width:1180px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 24px}
  a{text-decoration:none}

  /* ===== REAL SHOPIT CHROME ===== */
  /* contact bar */
  .shop-contact{background:var(--orange);color:#fff;font-size:13.5px}
  .shop-contact .wrap{display:flex;justify-content:flex-end;align-items:center;gap:18px;height:40px}
  .shop-contact .sep{opacity:.5}
  .shop-contact a{color:#fff}

  /* main orange header */
  .shop-head{background:var(--orange);color:#fff;padding-bottom:6px}
  .shop-head .top{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:30px;padding:6px 0 14px}
  .brand{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;font-weight:700;font-size:26px;color:#fff;flex:none}
  .brand .mark{display:flex;align-items:flex-end;gap:3px;height:26px}
  .brand .mark span{display:block;width:4px;background:#fff;border-radius:2px}
  .brand .mark .b1{height:11px}.brand .mark .b2{height:18px}.brand .mark .b3{height:26px}
  .brand .it{font-weight:500;font-size:18px;letter-spacing:.06em;opacity:.95}
  .search{flex:1;max-width:640px;margin:0 auto;position:relative}
  .search input{width:100%;border:none;border-radius:40px;padding:15px 56px 15px 22px;font-size:15px;font-family:inherit}
  .search input:focus{outline:none}
  .search .go{position:absolute;right:6px;top:6px;width:42px;height:42px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--orange);border:none;color:#fff;cursor:pointer;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center}
  .search .go svg{width:20px;height:20px;stroke:#fff;fill:none;stroke-width:2.4}
  .head-right{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;flex:none}
  .vat{text-align:right;line-height:1.1}
  .vat .price{font-size:16px;font-weight:600}
  .vat .lbl{font-size:12px;font-style:italic;opacity:.9}
  .cart svg{width:30px;height:30px;stroke:#fff;fill:none;stroke-width:1.8}

  /* nav row */
  .shop-nav{background:var(--orange);border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.18)}
  .shop-nav .wrap{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:26px;height:54px;color:#fff;font-size:15.5px;font-weight:500;flex-wrap:wrap}
  .shop-nav a{color:#fff;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:7px}
  .shop-nav a:hover{opacity:.82}
  .shop-nav .pipe{opacity:.55;font-weight:400}
  .shop-nav .acct{margin-left:auto;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px}
  @media(max-width:900px){
    .shop-nav .wrap{gap:16px;font-size:14px;height:auto;padding-top:10px;padding-bottom:10px}
    .shop-contact .wrap{justify-content:center;gap:10px;font-size:12px}
    .search{order:3;flex-basis:100%;max-width:none;margin-top:8px}
    .brand{font-size:22px}
  }

  /* ===== HERO ===== */
  .hero{background:radial-gradient(1100px 520px at 78% 18%, rgba(238,118,35,.22), transparent 60%),linear-gradient(160deg,#2c3033 0%,#25282A 45%,#1b1e20 100%);color:#fff;overflow:hidden;position:relative}
  .hero::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:radial-gradient(680px 420px at 12% 92%, rgba(244,175,35,.10), transparent 60%);pointer-events:none;z-index:1}
  .hero .orange-arc{position:absolute;top:-90px;left:-110px;width:340px;height:340px;background:radial-gradient(circle at 35% 35%, var(--yellow), var(--orange) 55%, var(--orange-dk));border-radius:50%;opacity:.92;filter:blur(.5px);box-shadow:0 30px 80px rgba(238,118,35,.35)}
  .hero-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.05fr .95fr;gap:40px;align-items:center;padding:150px 0 140px;position:relative;z-index:2}
  .eyebrow{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;background:rgba(244,175,35,.14);color:var(--yellow);border:1px solid rgba(244,175,35,.45);padding:7px 16px;border-radius:30px;font-size:13px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;margin-bottom:24px;backdrop-filter:blur(4px)}
  .eyebrow::before{content:"";width:7px;height:7px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--yellow);box-shadow:0 0 0 4px rgba(244,175,35,.22)}
  .hero h1{font-family:var(--head);font-size:clamp(38px,5.6vw,66px);line-height:1.02;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:-.025em;margin-bottom:20px;color:#fff}
  .hero h1 .accent{color:#fff}
  .hero p.lede{font-size:20px;color:#c7d0d6;max-width:460px;margin-bottom:32px}
  .offer{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:18px;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.14);border-radius:16px;padding:18px 26px;margin-bottom:30px;background:linear-gradient(145deg,rgba(255,255,255,.07),rgba(0,0,0,.18));box-shadow:0 18px 40px rgba(0,0,0,.28);backdrop-filter:blur(6px)}
  .offer .upto{font-size:13px;font-weight:800;line-height:1;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.06em;color:#e7edf1}
  .offer .big{font-size:60px;font-weight:800;line-height:.9;display:flex;align-items:flex-start;background:linear-gradient(180deg,var(--yellow),var(--orange));-webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;-webkit-text-fill-color:transparent}
  .offer .big sup{font-size:26px;margin-top:6px;-webkit-text-fill-color:var(--orange)}
  .offer .off{font-size:16px;font-weight:800;align-self:flex-end;margin-bottom:8px}
  .offer .sub{font-size:14px;color:#c7d0d6;max-width:170px;border-left:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.2);padding-left:16px}
  .hero-meta{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;color:#9fb0ba;font-size:13.5px;margin-top:18px}
  .hero-meta svg{width:16px;height:16px;stroke:var(--yellow);fill:none;stroke-width:2;flex:none}
  .hero-meta .dot{width:4px;height:4px;border-radius:50%;background:#586671}
  .hero-cta{display:flex;gap:14px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:4px;margin-bottom:72px}
  .btn-primary{background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--orange),var(--orange-dk));color:#fff;padding:16px 32px;border-radius:10px;font-weight:700;font-size:16px;transition:transform .18s ease,box-shadow .18s ease;display:inline-block;box-shadow:0 12px 26px rgba(238,118,35,.32)}
  .btn-primary:hover{transform:translateY(-2px);box-shadow:0 18px 36px rgba(238,118,35,.42)}
  .btn-ghost{border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.38);color:#fff;padding:16px 32px;border-radius:10px;font-weight:700;font-size:16px;display:inline-block;transition:background .18s ease,border-color .18s ease}
  .btn-ghost:hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,.10);border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.6)}
  .hero-visual{position:relative;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center}
  .device-stage{width:100%;aspect-ratio:4/3;border-radius:14px;background:radial-gradient(circle at 60% 40%, rgba(0,120,215,.25), transparent 60%),linear-gradient(160deg,#0d1114,#22292e);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;flex-direction:column;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08);text-align:center;padding:24px}
  .device-stage .cam{width:30px;height:8px;background:#0a0d10;border-radius:6px;margin-bottom:-2px;position:relative;z-index:2}
  .device-stage .mon{width:78%;height:58%;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#1a73e8,#0b3d91);border-radius:8px 8px 0 0;border:4px solid #0a0d10;border-bottom:none;box-shadow:0 20px 50px rgba(0,0,0,.5)}
  .device-stage .stand{width:60px;height:34px;background:#0a0d10;border-radius:0 0 6px 6px}
  .lenovo-chip{position:absolute;bottom:18px;right:18px;background:var(--lenovo);color:#fff;font-weight:800;font-size:18px;padding:8px 16px;border-radius:5px}
  @media(max-width:820px){.hero-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;padding:104px 0 96px}.hero-visual{order:-1}}

  /* ===== TRUST STRIP ===== */
  .trust{background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--orange),var(--orange-dk));color:#fff;position:relative}
  .trust-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr)}
  .trust-col{padding:42px 30px;text-align:center;border-right:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.18);transition:background .2s ease}
  .trust-col:last-child{border-right:none}
  .trust-col:hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,.07)}
  .trust-col .ico{width:62px;height:62px;margin:0 auto 16px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;border-radius:16px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.14);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.25)}
  .trust-col .ico svg{width:32px;height:32px;stroke:#fff;fill:none;stroke-width:2}
  .trust-col h3{font-family:var(--head);font-size:16px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.06em;text-transform:uppercase;margin-bottom:10px}
  .trust-col p{font-size:14.5px;color:#fff0e6;max-width:260px;margin:0 auto}
  @media(max-width:720px){.trust-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}.trust-col{border-right:none;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.25)}}

  /* ===== INTRO ===== */
  .intro{padding:76px 0;text-align:center}
  .intro h2{font-family:var(--head);font-size:clamp(26px,3.6vw,38px);font-weight:800;letter-spacing:-.01em;margin-bottom:20px;max-width:760px;margin-inline:auto}
  .intro h2::after{content:"";display:block;width:64px;height:4px;border-radius:4px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--orange),var(--yellow));margin:18px auto 0}
  .intro p{font-size:18px;color:var(--muted);max-width:680px;margin:0 auto}

  /* ===== PRODUCTS ===== */
  .products{background:var(--mist);padding:68px 0}
  .sec-head{text-align:center;margin-bottom:44px}
  .sec-head .kicker{display:inline-block;color:var(--orange);font-weight:800;font-size:13px;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;background:rgba(238,118,35,.1);padding:6px 14px;border-radius:20px}
  .sec-head h2{font-family:var(--head);font-size:clamp(26px,3.4vw,36px);font-weight:800;margin-top:14px}
  .cards{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:26px}
  .card{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:18px;overflow:hidden;display:flex;flex-direction:column;transition:transform .2s ease,box-shadow .2s ease,border-color .2s ease}
  .card:hover{transform:translateY(-6px);box-shadow:0 24px 50px rgba(31,38,43,.16);border-color:rgba(238,118,35,.4)}
  .card .img{aspect-ratio:16/11;background:linear-gradient(160deg,#fbfcfd,#eef2f5);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;position:relative;overflow:hidden;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
  .card .img img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:contain;padding:14px}
  .card .img .scr{width:62%;height:60%;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#1a73e8,#0b3d91);border-radius:6px;border:4px solid #05080a;box-shadow:0 12px 28px rgba(0,0,0,.45)}
  .card .tag{position:absolute;top:14px;right:14px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--orange),var(--orange-dk));color:#fff;font-size:12px;font-weight:800;padding:6px 12px;border-radius:20px;letter-spacing:.03em;box-shadow:0 6px 14px rgba(238,118,35,.3)}
  .card .body{padding:24px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;flex:1}
  .card h3{font-family:var(--head);font-size:20px;font-weight:800;margin-bottom:6px}
  .card .cat{font-size:13px;color:var(--muted);text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.06em;margin-bottom:12px}
  .card ul{list-style:none;margin-bottom:18px;font-size:14.5px}
  .card ul li{padding:5px 0 5px 22px;position:relative;color:#3c474e}
  .card ul li::before{content:"";position:absolute;left:0;top:11px;width:11px;height:6px;border-left:2px solid var(--orange);border-bottom:2px solid var(--orange);transform:rotate(-45deg)}
  .card .price{margin-top:auto;display:flex;align-items:baseline;gap:10px;margin-bottom:16px}
  .card .price .now{font-size:24px;font-weight:800}
  .card .price .was{font-size:15px;color:#9aa6ad;text-decoration:line-through}
  .card .price .save{font-size:12px;font-weight:800;color:var(--orange);background:rgba(236,102,8,.1);padding:3px 9px;border-radius:20px}
  .card .price .exvat{font-size:12px;color:#9aa6ad;font-weight:600}
  .card .card-btn{text-align:center;background:var(--ink);color:#fff;padding:13px;border-radius:10px;font-weight:700;font-size:15px;transition:background .18s ease;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px}
  .card .card-btn svg{width:16px;height:16px;stroke:currentColor;fill:none;stroke-width:2.4;transition:transform .18s ease}
  .card .card-btn:hover{background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--orange),var(--orange-dk))}
  .card:hover .card-btn svg{transform:translateX(3px)}
  @media(max-width:880px){.cards{grid-template-columns:1fr;max-width:420px;margin:0 auto}}

  /* ===== STEPS ===== */
  .steps{padding:76px 0;background:var(--paper)}
  .step-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:30px;position:relative}
  .step-grid::before{content:"";position:absolute;top:27px;left:16%;right:16%;height:2px;background:repeating-linear-gradient(90deg,var(--line) 0 10px,transparent 10px 18px);z-index:0}
  .step{position:relative;z-index:1;text-align:center}
  .step .num{width:54px;height:54px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:24px;font-weight:800;color:#fff;background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--orange),var(--orange-dk));border-radius:50%;line-height:1;margin:0 auto 18px;box-shadow:0 10px 22px rgba(238,118,35,.3);border:4px solid #fff}
  .step h3{font-size:18px;font-weight:800;margin-bottom:8px}
  .step p{color:var(--muted);font-size:15px;max-width:300px;margin:0 auto}
  @media(max-width:720px){.step-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}.step-grid::before{display:none}}

  /* ===== LEAD ===== */
  .lead{background:radial-gradient(900px 480px at 85% 10%, rgba(238,118,35,.18), transparent 60%),linear-gradient(160deg,#2c3033,#1b1e20);color:#fff;padding:80px 0;position:relative;overflow:hidden}
  .lead-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:50px;align-items:center;position:relative;z-index:1}
  .lead h2{font-family:var(--head);font-size:clamp(28px,3.6vw,40px);font-weight:800;margin-bottom:16px;line-height:1.1}
  .lead p{color:#c7d0d6;font-size:17px;margin-bottom:24px;max-width:440px}
  .lead .bullets{list-style:none;font-size:15.5px}
  .lead .bullets li{padding:8px 0 8px 30px;position:relative;color:#dfe5e9}
  .lead .bullets li::before{content:"";position:absolute;left:0;top:13px;width:13px;height:7px;border-left:2.5px solid var(--orange);border-bottom:2.5px solid var(--orange);transform:rotate(-45deg)}
  .form-card{background:#fff;border-radius:20px;padding:34px;color:var(--ink);box-shadow:0 30px 70px rgba(0,0,0,.4);border-top:4px solid var(--orange)}
  .form-card h3{font-size:21px;font-weight:800;margin-bottom:4px}
  .form-card .sm{font-size:14px;color:var(--muted);margin-bottom:20px}
  .field{margin-bottom:14px}
  .field label{display:block;font-size:13px;font-weight:700;margin-bottom:6px}
  .field input,.field select,.field textarea{width:100%;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:8px;padding:12px 14px;font-size:15px;font-family:inherit;background:var(--mist)}
  .field input:focus,.field select:focus,.field textarea:focus{outline:2px solid var(--orange);background:#fff}
  .row2{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:14px}
  .submit{width:100%;background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--orange),var(--orange-dk));color:#fff;border:none;cursor:pointer;padding:16px;border-radius:10px;font-weight:800;font-size:16px;margin-top:6px;transition:transform .18s ease,box-shadow .18s ease;box-shadow:0 12px 26px rgba(238,118,35,.32)}
  .submit:hover{transform:translateY(-2px);box-shadow:0 18px 36px rgba(238,118,35,.42)}
  .form-note{font-size:12px;color:var(--muted);text-align:center;margin-top:12px}
  /* Real ShopIT mailform, styled to match */
  .form-card mailform{display:block}
  .form-card mailform label{display:block;margin-bottom:14px}
  .form-card mailform .input-label{display:block;font-size:13px;font-weight:700;margin-bottom:6px;color:var(--ink)}
  .form-card mailform input,.form-card mailform textarea{width:100%;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:8px;padding:12px 14px;font-size:15px;font-family:inherit;background:var(--mist)}
  .form-card mailform input:focus,.form-card mailform textarea:focus{outline:2px solid var(--orange);background:#fff}
  .form-card mailform .content-mail-form-button{width:100%;background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--orange),var(--orange-dk));color:#fff;border:none;cursor:pointer;padding:16px;border-radius:10px;font-weight:800;font-size:16px;margin-top:6px;box-shadow:0 12px 26px rgba(238,118,35,.32);transition:transform .18s ease,box-shadow .18s ease}
  .form-card mailform .content-mail-form-button:hover{transform:translateY(-2px);box-shadow:0 18px 36px rgba(238,118,35,.42)}
  @media(max-width:820px){.lead-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}.row2{grid-template-columns:1fr}}

  /* ===== FOOTER ===== */
  footer{background:var(--ink-2);color:#9aa6ad;padding:46px 0 30px;font-size:14px}
  .foot-grid{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:20px;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08);padding-bottom:26px;margin-bottom:22px}
  .foot-links{display:flex;gap:24px;flex-wrap:wrap}
  .foot-links a{color:#9aa6ad}
  .foot-links a:hover{color:#fff}
  .copy{font-size:13px;color:#6c7880}

  .mock-note{background:#fff8f1;border-bottom:2px dashed var(--orange);color:#9a5b1e;text-align:center;font-size:13px;padding:9px;font-weight:600}

  .hero-photo{width:140%;max-width:880px;height:auto;display:block;margin:0 auto;
    filter:drop-shadow(0 30px 50px rgba(0,0,0,.55));
    animation:heroFloat 5.5s ease-in-out infinite}
  @media(max-width:820px){.hero-photo{width:100%;max-width:560px}}
  @keyframes heroFloat{0%,100%{transform:translateY(0)}50%{transform:translateY(-12px)}}
  .hero-visual{position:relative}
  .hero-visual::before{content:"";position:absolute;top:50%;left:50%;
    width:88%;height:88%;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);
    background:radial-gradient(circle, rgba(238,118,35,.35), transparent 68%);
    filter:blur(28px);z-index:0;pointer-events:none}
  .hero-photo{position:relative;z-index:1}
  @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce){.hero-photo{animation:none}}


  /* Full-bleed: section backgrounds span the whole viewport width */
  .lenovo-lp .hero,
  .lenovo-lp .trust,
  .lenovo-lp .intro,
  .lenovo-lp .products,
  .lenovo-lp .steps,
  .lenovo-lp .lead,
  .lenovo-lp footer{
    width:100vw;
    position:relative;
    left:50%;
    right:50%;
    margin-left:-50vw;
    margin-right:-50vw;
  }
  /* Inner content stays centred and readable */
  .lenovo-lp .wrap{max-width:1180px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 24px}


  /* Remove any white gap above the hero and guard seams */
  .lenovo-lp{background:var(--ink)}
  /* Pull the page up under the store menu to close the white gap.
     If a small white strip remains, increase this number (e.g. -40px);
     if the hero slips under the menu, reduce it (e.g. -16px). */
  .lenovo-lp{margin-top:-32px}
  .lenovo-lp .hero{margin-top:0}
  .lenovo-lp > .hero:first-child,
  .lenovo-lp .hero:first-of-type{margin-top:0;padding-top:0}

</style>
<style>
.lenovo-lp, .lenovo-lp *{box-sizing:border-box}
.lenovo-lp{font-family:'Gotham Rounded','Montserrat','Segoe UI','Helvetica Neue',Arial,sans-serif;line-height:1.55;color:#25282A}
.lenovo-lp .wrap{max-width:1180px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 24px}
.lenovo-lp a{text-decoration:none}
.lenovo-lp section{margin:0}

  /* Force breathing room below hero CTA buttons on every screen size */
  .lenovo-lp .hero .hero-cta{margin-bottom:72px !important}
  @media (max-width:820px){
    .lenovo-lp .hero .hero-cta{margin-bottom:56px !important}
  }


  /* Fix: ensure content containers are centred (override stray header .wrap flex rules) */
  .lenovo-lp .hero .wrap,
  .lenovo-lp .trust .wrap,
  .lenovo-lp .intro .wrap,
  .lenovo-lp .products .wrap,
  .lenovo-lp .steps .wrap,
  .lenovo-lp .lead .wrap,
